description: A test suite for non-deterministic code: a dataset of inputs, scorers that check properties of each output, and a report of how often the feature behaves.
Curated cases with stable ids and expected answers or required facts, taken from real usage and grown from production failures.
A function `(output, case) → { pass, score, detail }`. Code-based scorers (exact, regex, schema) are cheap and deterministic; model-based scorers need calibration.
Removing noise such as case, edge whitespace and punctuation before an exact comparison, never meaning.
Compares an output to a reference answer by embedding similarity. Rewards shared vocabulary, so its threshold must be calibrated on labeled outputs.
Judging a change from a few hand-picked tries. The bad practice evals replace.
Writing eval cases before changing a prompt, model or tool, then comparing the new run with a baseline.
